game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against yeti raiders. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the firewood keeper ahead. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the hearth fire by solving code steps involving spells that move the firewood keeper forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the hearth fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
